title: artifact_manifest
description: Shared creative-artifact version & lineage record for one authoring mission. Every literary vertical (fiction, poetry, prose, editor) records the artifacts it produces (brief, plan, draft, state, review, revision, final, ...) as a DAG: each artifact names its `parent_artifact_ids` (what it was derived from) and optionally the artifact it `supersedes` (the earlier version it replaces). This is what makes provenance auditable — which draft and which review a `final` deliverable descends from — and version history explicit. `kind` is a free string validated against a PER-VERTICAL vocabulary by verticals.literary.shared.artifact_manifest, never hardcoded here. Semantic invariants the schema cannot express (unique ids, parent/supersedes existence, acyclicity, supersedes<->superseded coherence) are enforced by validate_manifest.
